title: Publication ticket
description: One reserved attempt bound to one exact publication: the operation, the target, and the hash of the exact bytes. Issued by reserve-attempt, consumed once by the controlled publisher, dead after 30 minutes. A record, not a credential: anyone able to write the file can write a consistent one.

operation.description: The two supported operations, copied from the receipt. pr-create is retired: its result cannot be fully bound under the current contract, so a pre-retirement pr-create ticket fails validation and the publisher names the reason.

targetNumber.description: The issue or pull request being commented on. Null for the operations that create one, whose number does not exist yet.

bodySha256.description: Digest of the normalized body: BOM stripped, line endings folded to LF, trailing newlines dropped. The publisher recomputes it before consuming and again over the body fetched back after publishing.

titleSha256.description: Copied from the receipt's binding: non-null for issue-create, null for issue-comment. The publisher verifies the title file against it before consuming.

dependsOn.description: Copied from the receipt's binding and bound in the ticket id: the lineages that must have published before this ticket may be spent. The publisher re-checks every one before consuming, without re-reading the receipt.

sessionId.description: Recorded, never enforced: it says which session reserved, and proves nothing about which one publishes.
